recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy digital composite featuring a central female figure in swimwear standing before a red sports car, set against a dark background illuminated by cyan light streaks and heavy 3D metallic typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The red car acts as a horizontal anchor against the vertical subject.
Cyan light trails create a sense of motion and speed behind the static subjects.
The 3D title typography overlaps the background glow to create depth.
Reflections on the ground plane ground the car and subject in a virtual space.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central female figure at 60% height, positioned directly in front of a mid-ground sports car.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red sports car provides the primary color weight and horizontal stability.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the large 3D title, moves down to the central figure, then follows the car's lines to the secondary text in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark upper corners and lower ground plane allow the central subjects and light effects to pop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and cyan (background and atmosphere)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red (sports car and secondary text accents)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White and silver (metallic text highlights and light flares)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the car and cyan glows against a low-value, dark environment.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cyan, red, black, and silver

letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing with slight overlaps
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are merged at the base to create a singular 3D block effect
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A clean, light-weight sans-serif for metadata to contrast the heavy, textured display type.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and verticality for the 3D effect.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark studio scene with a glossy red supercar and a female model in black swimwear. Add cyan light trails and motion streaks horizontally across the frame. Include a reflective dark floor.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add 3D metallic uppercase text in the upper third, tilted slightly. Apply a cyan outer glow to the text. Place secondary metadata text in the bottom right corner using a clean white sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the 3D text the most prominent element?
Does the cyan glow contrast sharply with the red car?
Is the model positioned centrally to create symmetry?

adjustableVariables: Angle of the diagonal hazard stripes
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic reflections on the car surface.
Ensure the 3D text perspective matches the camera angle.
Verify that the cyan glow does not wash out the model's features.
Confirm the hazard stripes are restricted to the corner.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Supercar] + [Central Model] + [Cyan Motion Streaks] + [3D Metallic Display Type] for a high-energy electronic music aesthetic.
